rationale: AssertionError defines [inspect.custom], where inspect.custom = customInspectSymbol (inspect.js:411). formatValue reads value[customInspectSymbol] (a non-literal computed key) and invokes it via FunctionPrototypeCall(maybeCustom, context, ...), so any util.inspect of an AssertionError (e.g. in assert tests and error printing) reaches it. This is a function looked up on an object by a computed key and invoked, the intent of dynamic-property-keyed-callback; fp-novel is defensible since the invocation goes through a local plus FunctionPrototypeCall rather than a direct obj[key]() expression and is really a symbol-protocol hook.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The prior regression verdict citing value[customInspectSymbol] in formatValue is correct in evidence and rule.
